name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Predictive input buffer: a ghost simulates your click ahead and delays it if clicking now would kill you. Live console, F4 window key, repeat on orbs while held.

window-ticks.name: Max delay (ticks)
window-ticks.description: Max delay the buffer may add to a click. 240 ticks per second: 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS. F4 cycles 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, OFF.

cycle-key.name: Key: cycle window
cycle-key.description: In a level, cycles the buffer window: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 ticks, then OFF, then back to 1.

repeat-held.name: Repeat while held
repeat-held.description: While you hold the click, touching a new orb clicks again so the orb is used.

smart-prediction.name: Orb / pad / portal prediction
smart-prediction.description: Let the ghost use orbs, pads, gravity portals and speed portals. Turn off if you see glitches with objects.

sim-budget-ms.name: Prediction time budget (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: Max time spent predicting per click. Higher finds longer saves but may hitch on dense levels.

console.name: Live console
console.description: Opens a console window showing window changes and SAVED clicks (with how many ticks they were delayed). Needs a restart.
